title: [Interview] Ukraine’s former defence chief predicts new EU security alliance, gives behind-the-scenes look at Russia diplomacy
lede: What happens behind the scenes at peace talks with Russia and in negotiations with allies? Oleksii Reznikov, Ukrainian defence minister at the start of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022, spoke candidly about his time leading his country's defence efforts. Now lecturing university students about negotiating tactics, he says Europe might soon see a new security alliance.
